verdicts.quote: C-12: Automatic reminders are limited to one accepted reminder per invoice. C-9: An invoice due June 10 fails the timing check through the end of June 10 and passes it starting June 11

A voided, canceled or fully written-off invoice generates zero automatic submissions; A posted credit reduces an invoice's recorded outstanding balance to zero. The invoice generates no automatic reminder.
verdicts.missing: Whether a disputed invoice or one on a payment plan stops the reminder; neither condition is mentioned.

verdicts.quote: An invoice originally for 100 USD with 25 USD paid yields a reminder stating 75 USD outstanding when the remainder is still owed at submission.
Two evaluations find the same eligible invoice before either submits. At most one submission to the delivery service is in progress for that invoice at a time.
An invoice qualifies when evaluated. Billing records full payment before submission to the delivery service begins. The service receives zero submissions for that invoice.
The email service definitively refuses a submission for a temporary reason. A later attempt occurs automatically if the invoice still qualifies.
verdicts.missing: Any cap on repeated temporary retries and any alert or escalation to a person when sending keeps failing; failures are only visible if an operator looks.

verdicts.quote: The unaccepted reminder remains eligible for reconsideration when there is capacity. The service's exact rate and quota are unconfirmed.
verdicts.missing: How a large batch is paced or throttled to stay within the provider's rate limit, as opposed to reacting after the quota is exhausted.

verdicts.quote: An invoice issued before activation that satisfies the current eligibility rules can receive its automatic reminder after activation.
verdicts.missing: Whether the backlog of already-overdue invoices is spread out or limited at activation rather than all sent at once.

verdicts.quote: Reminder timing uses the workspace's existing billing time zone when available ... Daily evaluation follows the date-based due policy without fixing an hour.
verdicts.missing: The customer's local time, sending hours, and whether weekends or holidays are avoided.

verdicts.quote: A reminder for 75 CAD outstanding identifies the amount as Canadian dollars unambiguously.
verdicts.missing: How the amount is formatted for the recipient (locale, symbol, decimal conventions).

verdicts.quote: An invoice without a usable billing recipient generates zero automatic submissions. ... The service definitively rejects a mailbox as nonexistent. Later evaluations ... make zero submissions to that unchanged mailbox.

The invoice reminder is addressed to the designated billing recipient. ... Billing data offers competing recipients without a designated destination. No automatic reminder is submitted for the invoice.
An operator opens an accessible invoice's reminder history and can identify the outcome and time of recorded attempts.
A customer can discover where to view or deal with the invoice from the reminder. The route can be an existing invoice link or an existing billing contact or access instruction.
verdicts.missing: Whether the due date appears in the reminder, and whether a payment or invoice link expires.

verdicts.quote: A user without that permission attempts to enable or disable reminders and receives a refusal.
verdicts.missing: Who may stop an individual invoice's reminder by hand; manual sending is only deferred to existing permissions, and the schedule itself is not configurable.

verdicts.quote: The operator disables the feature and sees the disabled state.
verdicts.missing: A per-customer off switch, a preview or dry run of the actual reminders, and a new manual resend action (only existing manual sends are preserved).

verdicts.quote: A provider-wide limit is reached before an otherwise ready invoice can be attempted. The operator can tell that the invoice is awaiting capacity.
verdicts.missing: A view of upcoming reminders, i.e. what the system will send next, and a workspace-wide list of failed sends rather than per-invoice history.

verdicts.quote: The first reminder is submitted before June 12 in the billing time zone.
verdicts.missing: A maximum lateness after which a missed reminder is dropped (C-53 lets it go out at any time after recovery) and any overall cap on sending volume.

verdicts.quote: Compare the invoice's amount, balance, currency, due date and payment history immediately before and after an accepted reminder with no other billing activity. All financial values are identical.
